   [b i u]Rename math.js → calc.js[/]                                                                         
                                                                                                    
   [b]Context[/]                                                                                          
                                                                                                    
   The repo contains a single source file, [fg=#b1b9f9]math.js[/] (34 bytes, one [fg=#b1b9f9]add[/] function). The user wants     
   it                                                                                               
   renamed to [fg=#b1b9f9]calc.js[/]. A grep across the working tree found no other file referencing [fg=#b1b9f9]math[/], so      
   this                                                                                             
   is a self-contained rename with no import sites to update.                                       
                                                                                                    
   Note: [fg=#b1b9f9]math.js[/] currently has uncommitted modifications ([fg=#b1b9f9]git status[/] shows [fg=#b1b9f9] M math.js[/]). Using       
   [fg=#b1b9f9]git mv[/] preserves that staged/unstaged content and records the rename.                            
                                                                                                    
   [b]Step 1 — Rename the file[/]                                                                         
                                                                                                    
   git [fg=#008080]mv[/] math.js calc.js                                                                           
                                                                                                    
   Critical file: [fg=#b1b9f9]math.js[/] → [fg=#b1b9f9]calc.js[/]. Contents unchanged:                                            
                                                                                                    
   [fg=#000080]function[/] [fg=#808000]add[/](a,b){ [fg=#000080]return[/] a + b }
